title: Memory Garden
pitch: Reveal little animated creatures, remember their positions and clear a compact board of matching pairs.
capabilities: Multiple Rive instances/artboards in one surface
rules: Seeded paired deck; reveal at most two eligible tiles. Match identity is app state, not sprite equality.
A mismatch remains visible for a short active-time interval, then closes. Input during resolution is explicitly gated.
Win when every pair is matched; timers and scores are local only.
content: Three board sizes, twelve original creature motifs and untimed practice.
